text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- According to unofficial results of Macedonia's local elections the ruling SDAM has won 40 towns, the opposition coalition IMRO-DPMNY-Democratic Party and MAAK conservative party, 20, while the Socialist Party and ethnic Albanian PDP have four.
- Second round of local elections in Macedonia passed calmly without any significant problems.

- Macedonian president Kiro Gligorov and foreign minister Ljubomir Frckoski are taking part in the OSCE meeting in Lisbon. President Gligorov is expected to address the meeting on Monday evening or Tuesday morning.
